title: Reporting contract
description: What check-report.mjs (git-commits-and-reporting) requires of an evidence report in this app. Every key is optional; a missing or null key takes the default.

locales.description: The app's locale codes. null: the file names of <i18n>/catalogs/*.json.

sliceChecks.description: Checks lines every slice report needs besides 'Types, lint, format' and 'Tests'. Each must name its evidence file.

releaseChecks.description: Checks lines a release report also needs. Default: Coverage, Mutation, End-to-end. Each must name its evidence file.

humanChecks.description: Checks a person does by hand; each is named in the 'Human checks (not blocking)' block of every slice and release report.

match.description: A case-insensitive regular expression a line of the block must match.

nonEvidenceMarkers.description: Words that mark a result which is not evidence (a rehearsal, a dry run, a placeholder FAIL); allowed only under 'Not tested or not verified', 'Details' and 'Human checks'.
